critical_risks.name: first_touch_comprehension
critical_risks.progress: Pre-game friction risk is now explicitly addressed: Level 1 is the first meaningful screen, with no mode selector/menu/Start/audio-unlock gate; first car tap performs gameplay immediately. Product target is controls available <=1.0s. Fresh uncoached comprehension evidence is still required.

critical_risks.name: fair_failure_retry
critical_risks.progress: H1 shared_exit_conflict is now implemented in Level Schema v2, JavaScript functional core, and Python state rules. Synthetic Python/JS parity PASS; Level 1 1,024-state regression PASS. Still open: actual Levels 10-12 presentation, <=1.5s retry experience, and fresh-player understanding/retry evidence.

critical_risks.name: difficulty_wave_control
critical_risks.progress: Difficulty Features v1, validated Beat Chart, and independently verified per-level structural envelopes now define the intended 12-Main waveform. Still open: actual authored levels and fresh-player agreement with intended difficulty.

critical_risks.name: content_variety
critical_risks.progress: Beat Chart defines distinct intended roles and novelty isolation across 14 slice levels. Still open: authored-level structural diversity and duplicate detection.

critical_risks.name: repeatable_level_production
critical_risks.retire_by: level schema + solver + measured production cost
critical_risks.progress: Logic/data pipeline remains advanced. Visual production has retired one major risk: the reusable 10-car MASTER-derived production sprite set is now PASS, hash-locked, and committed. Remaining visual blocker is clean_plate.webp plus Level 1 rebuild without patch dependency; Level 2 remains locked.

critical_risks.progress: Runtime QA passes after instant-start/audio hardening, and the 10 production car sprites are now present. Still open: production clean plate + Level 1 clean-plate/sprite rebuild, then target-iPhone repeated solve/restart and saved screen-recording verification of clean internal SFX.
